verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for a SaaS HR/payroll platform like Justworks, for example through cookie or analytics opt-outs. However, the evidence pack covers only payroll, benefits, time off, onboarding and Xero integration docs, plus failed llms.txt and OpenAPI probes. Nothing in it addresses telemetry, tracking, or privacy opt-out controls.
